purpose: Validate combined TP2/PP2 AR and static target-KV DSpark serving, owner-local Mooncake capture, natural retraction and post-exit readback
draft: Synthetic target-KV DSpark checkpoints, including biased token-100 pressure replies; no trained-model quality claim
transport: Real Mooncake TCP for P/D KV transfer and Store
assertions: Complete manifests retain owner-local TP head and PP layer shards and report the actual destination topology.
Independent online observers compare selected KV, raw top-128 logits/IDs, full-vocabulary LSE, token IDs, loss masks, positions and terminal validity.
Combined P/D covers AR, draft on D only and draft on both sides, with single-token/chunked/cached prompts, rejected proposals, batching, first-teacher faults and cancellation.
Colocated serving compares greedy output against AR at the same topology and checks grammar, penalties, stop trimming, cancellation and prefix reuse.
Every TP/PP rank's retraction counter equals logical request retractions, and every retired draft context is rebuilt on each rank.
P/D restore compares every local target layer with an independent pre-offload copy and excludes the original failed capture lease from publication.
All 98 counted snapshots are fully reread with object digest and content validation after producer process trees exit; synthetic seed snapshots are excluded.

temporary.image_adjustment: Removed system flashinfer-cubin 0.6.12 and flashinfer-jit-cache 0.6.12+cu130 so the shared FlashInfer 0.6.17 environment is used

runs.post_exit_count_note: The monolithic fixture does not establish the strict full-process-tree exit invariant used for the 98 counted snapshots; do not add its READY log entries to that total.

source_freezing: Each run lists hashes for the relevant test and shared helper files, checked equal to the final checkout. The earlier frozen directories differ only in unrelated later colocated-test changes; production sources are unchanged.
limitations: Qwen3-0.6B with synthetic checkpoints; production exporter and trained-draft quality remain open
TP2 shards eight target KV heads; real replicated-head topologies and other models remain open
Synchronous PP and dense unquantized device KV pools; no asynchronous PP or distributed prefill graph claim
Matching combined P/D only; asymmetric combined topology and cross-node combined RDMA remain open
HTTP Catalog test double; production retention and consumer integration remain open
Observers synchronize/copy tensors; no throughput, latency or serving SLO claim
Colocated retraction recomputes context, while P/D uses ordinary request CPU backup/restore; HiCache and optional P/D KV offload are separate
